In Rawalpindi's first innings, the team was bowled out for 233 in 70 overs, led by Mohammad Sohaib with 74 and Mohammad Ahmad with 57, while Naqeebullah and Ibtisam Azhar took four wickets each. Rawalpindi's second innings saw Idrees Hayat score 72 before Ibtisam Azhar claimed 5-63.

Lahore Blues scored 222-9 in their first innings of 70 overs, featuring contributions from Daud Tauqir Rana (47), Haseeb Ur Rehman (44), and Khawaja Hamid Ali Khan (29), while Mohammad Hasan Khan picked up 6-68. Daud Tauqir Rana was rightfully named player of the match for his stellar batting performances throughout the final.

stories.title: Karachi Triumphs in PIA Aircraft Cabin Cleanliness Competition
stories.summary: Karachi secured the top position in Pakistan International Airlines' aircraft cabin cleanliness competition, while Lahore finished as the runner-up. The contest evaluated airline stations in Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad as part of a wider initiative to elevate passenger experience, service quality, and maintenance standards across the fleet. Evaluation teams inspected aircraft to measure cleanliness during a special simultaneous cleaning drive across the three stations. A recognition ceremony was subsequently hosted at the airline's Islamabad office to honor the employees whose performance stood out during the campaign. Outstanding staff members received shields, certificates, and cash awards for their contributions. Adrian Hamilton-Manns, the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer of Pakistan International Airlines, emphasized during the event that keeping aircraft in peak condition is a top priority for maintaining the airline's high brand standards. Hamilton-Manns, an aviation industry veteran with over thirty years of commercial experience including past leadership roles as CEO of three airlines in Africa, Kazakhstan, and Oman, recently assumed his office. Tasked with implementing operational reforms and restructuring, he is leading ongoing efforts to enhance overall service quality and strengthen the national carrier's standing within the global aviation industry.

stories.title: Prime Minister and President Honor Allama Iqbal on 149th Birth Anniversary
stories.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and President Asif Ali Zardari paid tribute to Allama Muhammad Iqbal, known as the poet of the East, on his 149th birth anniversary. Born in Sialkot in 1877, Iqbal was a philosopher, scholar, and poet who first articulated the two-nation theory during the 1930 Allahabad session of the Muslim League, paving the way for Pakistan's creation on August 14, 1947. Commemorations included a public holiday declared by the federal government and a Change of Guards ceremony held at his mausoleum in Lahore. In his official message, Prime Minister Shehbaz praised Iqbal for awakening political consciousness among subcontinent Muslims and announced a year-long program of national and international events leading up to the 150th anniversary on November 9, 2027. The premier highlighted Iqbal's concept of Khudi, or selfhood, and the metaphor of the Shaheen falcon, emphasizing peace, social harmony, and tolerance while rejecting extremism and discrimination. President Zardari also honored the philosopher, urging the nation's youth to draw inspiration from his poetry to develop critical inquiry faculties and pursue freedom, equality, and self-respect. Both leaders stressed that Iqbal's vision of unity, universal brotherhood, and independent national decision-making remains vital for Pakistan's development and its role within the region as it approaches an Asian century.

stories.title: لاہور میں پولیس نے بروقت کارروائی کر کے 13 سالہ بچی کی شادی ناکام بنا دی
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے لیاقت آباد میں پولیس نے بروقت کارروائی کرتے ہوئے کم عمر بچی کی شادی کی تقریب کو ناکام بنا دیا اور موقع سے کئی افراد کو گرفتار کر لیا۔

پولیس کے مطابق لیاقت آباد کے ایک مقامی شادی ہال میں تقریب جاری تھی جہاں تیرہ سالہ بچی کی رخصتی کی تیاری کی جا رہی تھی۔ پولیس ریکارڈ کے مطابق اس بچی کا نکاح رواں سال چار اکتوبر کو پڑھایا گیا تھا۔

اس غیر قانونی کارروائی پر فوری ایکشن لیتے ہوئے پولیس نے دولہا سبط الحسن اور بچی کے والد سبطین سمیت کل چھ ملزمان کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔

گرفتار کیے گئے تمام ملزمان کے خلاف تھانہ لیاقت آباد میں باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے اور اس کم عمر شادی کے معاملے پر مزید تفتیش کا عمل جاری ہے۔

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Faces Board Probe Over Foreign Intelligence Links
stories.summary: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang is facing an internal board investigation to determine if he was targeted in a foreign intelligence operation. The scrutiny follows a media report by The New York Times alleging that Huang had a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive at Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed. US authorities previously investigated Alice Huang, concluding she acted as a Chinese intelligence asset and allegedly passed information to Beijing. Megaspeed operates as an Nvidia customer and an Asia-Pacific cloud partner, offering advanced Nvidia chips that are restricted from shipment to China under US export controls. Jensen Huang, 63, co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and transformed the company into a dominant supplier of artificial intelligence processors, driving its market valuation from $420 billion in late 2022 to $4.5 trillion by November 6. Following the media report, senior Republicans in the US House of Representatives requested briefings from Huang due to national security concerns. Nvidia stated that an independent committee of directors, supported by outside legal counsel, is reviewing all available data, and the company currently has no reason to believe that corporate secrets or national security were compromised. Huang has expressed full support for the review and committed to cooperating fully with the investigation, which comes during a sensitive period for the tech giant amid investor questions regarding the sustainability of the ongoing AI boom and geopolitical tech tensions between Washington and Beijing.

stories.title: ناسا نے چاند پر بیس کے لیے ایک ملین ڈالر کا چیلنج دے دیا
stories.summary:
امریکی خلائی ادارے ناسا نے چاند پر مستقل انسانی اڈے کے قیام کے لیے ایک ملین ڈالر کا 'مون بیس اسٹوڈنٹ چیلنج' شروع کر دیا ہے۔ اس مقابلے میں امریکا بھر کے ہائی اسکولوں اور اعلیٰ تعلیمی اداروں کے طلبا کی ٹیمیں حصہ لیں گی۔ اس اقدام کا مقصد نوجوانوں کی تخلیقی اور سائنسی صلاحیتوں کو ابھارنا ہے۔

مقابلے کے تحت طلبا کو چاند پر ناسا کے مجوزہ اڈے کے لیے جدید ترین ڈیزائن تیار کرنے کا موقع ملے گا۔ اس کے علاوہ انہیں وہاں انسانی زندگی کے تسلسل کو ممکن بنانے سے متعلق پیش آنے والے عملی مسائل کے قابلِ عمل حل پیش کرنا ہوں گے۔

ناسا نے اس چیلنج کا باضابطہ اعلان ریاست فلوریڈا کے کینیڈی اسپیس سینٹر وزیٹر کمپلیکس میں منعقدہ 'میکس پاور' ایونٹ کے دوران کیا۔ یہ پورا پروگرام ادارے کے 'گولڈن ایج آف سائنس' منصوبے کا ایک اہم حصہ ہے۔

stories.title: Actress Hina Altaf Calls Out Male Passenger Over Uncomfortable Flight Staring Incident
stories.summary:
Pakistani actress Hina Altaf used her Instagram stories to share an unsettling encounter she faced while traveling on an airplane, calling out a male passenger for repeatedly and shamelessly staring at her. The television star posted a video of the individual seated nearby, expressing her strong displeasure over his behavior and drawing attention to the broader issue of personal space and harassment faced by women in public spaces.

According to the actress, the passenger continued to stare at her unhesitatingly throughout the journey. When he realized that she was recording his actions, he briefly attempted to hide his face before resuming the same behavior. Frustrated by the ordeal, Altaf captioned the video noting that the man kept staring without any shame, adding that she chose to document the incident to highlight his inappropriate conduct rather than letting it go unnoticed.

Alongside the footage, Altaf also published a photograph of herself seated in her airline seat, wearing a comfortable grey outfit, glasses, and a black face mask. Addressing potential victim-blaming mindsets, she explicitly questioned whether anything was wrong with her attire and answered that there clearly was not. Her remarks challenged the notion that a woman's clothing can ever serve as a justification or invitation for unwanted attention or harassment.

Altaf is a prominent Pakistani television actress, host, and former video jockey born in Karachi. Known for her work in popular serials such as Dil-e-Jaanam, Aatish, Dil-e-Gumshuda, and Rabba Mainu Maaf Kareen, she frequently utilizes her social media presence to advocate for women's safety. Her latest social media post serves as another reminder that public harassment during travel or at workplaces remains a serious concern that should never be dismissed.

stories.title: لاہور میں خطرناک اور لاپرواہ ڈرائیونگ پر خاتون ٹک ٹاکر گرفتار
stories.summary:
لاہور پولیس نے سڑکوں پر خطرناک کرتب دکھانے اور ٹریفک قوانین کی سنگین خلاف ورزی کرنے پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ایک معروف خاتون ٹک ٹاکر کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔ یہ کارروائی سٹی ٹریفک آفیسر لاہور سید عبدالرحیم شیرازی کی خصوصی ہدایت پر عمل میں لائی گئی۔

پولیس حکام کے مطابق گرفتار ہونے والی خاتون ٹک ٹاکر کی شناخت نور بٹ کے نام سے ہوئی ہے۔ موصوفہ نے شہر کے سی بی ڈی ایریا میں اپنی گاڑی کو زگ زیگ انداز میں چلاتے ہوئے انتہائی خطرناک ڈرائیونگ کی تھی، جس کی فوٹیجز بھی سامنے آئیں تھیں۔ ملزمہ کے خلاف تھانہ نصیر آباد میں باقاعدہ مقدمہ درج کیا گیا ہے اور انہیں کلمہ چوک کے قریب روکا گیا۔

سی ٹی او لاہور سید عبدالرحیم شیرازی نے اس موقع پر واضح کیا کہ شہریوں کی جان و مال کا تحفظ ان کی اولین ترجیح ہے۔ خطرناک ڈرائیونگ، روڈ ریج اور ون ویلنگ کرنے والوں کے خلاف زیرو ٹالرنس پالیسی کے تحت بلاامتیاز قانونی کارروائیاں جاری رہیں گی اور ایسے افراد کے خلاف محض چالان کی بجائے مقدمات درج کیے جائیں گے۔

اسی مہم کے دوران پولیس نے فیز 6 میں ایک اور کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ہیول گاڑی پر جعلی نمبر پلیٹس لگا کر ڈرفٹنگ کرنے والے عبیر الرحمن نامی نوجوان کو بھی گرفتار کیا۔ ٹریفک پولیس کے مطابق قانون شکنی کرنے والوں کو قانون کی گرفت میں لانے کے لیے سخت اقدامات جاری رکھے جائیں گے۔

stories.title: Islamabad Police Recover Rs 1.62 Billion in Stolen Goods
stories.summary:
Islamabad Capital Territory Police detained 20,883 suspects and retrieved stolen property valued exceeding Rs 1.62 billion during the initial ten months of the year. The total number of lawbreakers apprehended included 1,197 operatives belonging to 509 distinct criminal rings. These syndicates specialized in offenses such as robberies, street crimes, burglaries, and vehicle thefts across the capital region.

An official from the police department reported on Monday that law enforcement executed precise operations targeting gangs, proclaimed offenders, drug traffickers, and people unlawfully possessing or displaying weapons. The dismantled criminal groups yielded significant recoveries consisting of 194 vehicles, 668 motorcycles, precious gold ornaments, and high-value mobile devices worth millions of rupees.

The initiative forms part of broader security efforts administered by local authorities to maintain public safety and curb organized crime within the federal capital. Targeted actions continue to focus on neutralizing threats from persistent criminal networks operating in the area.

These ongoing policing measures matter because recovering substantial stolen assets and dismantling hundreds of gangs directly enhances urban safety and reduces property crimes. The comprehensive operations demonstrate law enforcement capability in tackling complex criminal enterprises within the metropolitan jurisdiction.

stories.title: اسلام آباد میں ورلڈ جونیئر ٹینس چیمپئن شپ کا شاندار آغاز
stories.summary:
پاکستان ٹینس فیڈریشن (پی ٹی ایف) کمپلیکس اسلام آباد میں جے-30 پی پی ایل پاکستان ورلڈ جونیئر ٹینس چیمپئن شپ کا باقاعدہ آغاز ہو گیا ہے۔ اس بین الاقوامی ایونٹ میں دنیا بھر کے 17 مختلف ممالک سے تعلق رکھنے والے 62 ہونہار کھلاڑی اپنی صلاحیتوں کا مظاہرہ کر رہے ہیں، جن میں 39 لڑکے اور 23 لڑکیاں شامل ہیں۔

چیمپئن شپ کی افتتاحی تقریب میں اسلام آباد ٹینس ایسوسی ایشن کے چیئرمین طارق مرتضیٰ، پی ٹی ایف کے صدر اعصام الحق قریشی سمیت دیگر اہم شخصیات موجود تھیں۔ اس ٹورنامنٹ میں روس، چین، تھائی لینڈ، آسٹریلیا، اسپین، کینیڈا، برطانیہ، جاپان اور میزبان پاکستان سمیت سترہ ممالک کے کھلاڑی حصہ لے رہے ہیں، جو نوجوان کھلاڑیوں کے لیے بین الاقوامی رینکنگ پوائنٹس حاصل کرنے کا سنہری موقع ہے۔

پہلے روز کھیلے جانے والے بوائز سنگلز کے مقابلوں میں پاکستان کے پانچ کھلاڑیوں عبدالباسط، حمزہ رومان، ریان خان، ایم حسن عثمانی اور احتشام ہمایوں نے شاندار کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے اپنے اپنے میچز جیت لیے اور اپنے گروپس میں سرفہرست پوزیشن حاصل کی۔ اس کے علاوہ دیگر غیر ملکی اور ملکی کھلاڑیوں کے درمیان بھی سخت مقابلے دیکھنے میں آئے۔

پاکستان پیٹرولیم لمیٹڈ (پی پی ایل) اس باوقار بین الاقوامی ایونٹ کا مرکزی اسپانسر ہے۔ منتظمین کے مطابق اس چیمپئن شپ کے اگلے مراحل کے مقابلے روزانہ صبح ساڑھے نو بجے شروع ہوں گے، جس سے ملک میں ٹینس کے کھیل کو مزید فروغ ملے گا۔

stories.title: Pakistani Actor Mahira Khan Shares Message on Vulnerability During Pregnancy
stories.summary:
Pakistani actor Mahira Khan utilized social media to highlight the significance of treating women with compassion and kindness during pregnancy and the postpartum period. Sharing a quote on her Instagram story, Khan drew attention to how a woman's treatment during these critical stages leaves a permanent impression, emphasizing that memories of how someone is supported during the most vulnerable phases of motherhood cannot be undone.

Although Khan did not direct the message at any specific individual, her post drew renewed focus to the emotional support and understanding required by women navigating pregnancy and early motherhood. The message coincides with a notable chapter in the actor's personal life as she anticipates the arrival of her second child. She publicly announced her pregnancy in September 2026 during an appearance at the Toronto International Film Festival by sharing photographs displaying her baby bump alongside a personal caption.

Khan previously married businessman Salim Karim in an intimate ceremony held in Bhurban in October 2023, and she is also mother to her son Azlan from a previous marriage to Ali Askari. Her recent social media share broadens the conversation surrounding pregnancy beyond physical changes, underlining the lasting impact of how women are treated and supported during emotionally and physically demanding times.

stories.title: Trump Says Fresh Iran Strikes Unlikely as Talks Progress
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated in a phone interview with CNN that he is highly unlikely to order fresh military strikes against Iran as long as diplomatic talks aimed at resolving the conflict continue to progress. Trump noted that avoiding further attacks depends on whether both nations sign a strong agreement, though he added that potential infrastructure targets, including 38 bridges, have already been identified if military action needs to resume.

Meanwhile, both the United States and Iran reported incidents involving shipping vessels in and near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's state television indicated that evening explosions might be linked to military activity in the waterway, where two oil tankers reportedly caught fire after hitting unauthorized routes and mines. The US military stated that its air force had disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, while UK maritime monitors reported a separate incident involving a bulk carrier near Khor Fakkan.

Domestically, Trump acknowledged that the conflict with Iran contributed to Republican defeats in recent US midterm elections, while Vice President JD Vance explicitly stated that the war was the primary reason for the losses. Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended the administration's stance, describing the Iranian threat as real and noting that current diplomatic efforts have stalled because Iranian demands are unrealistic.

Qatar continues mediation efforts, denying claims that a deal has failed, while a senior Iranian official confirmed Tehran submitted a nuclear proposal dependent on prior sanctions relief, asset access, and war reparations. The ongoing disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz continue to impact global energy exports and international commodity markets, highlighting the critical economic stakes of the conflict.

stories.title: Karachi Industrial Hubs Suffer from Severe Infrastructure Decay
stories.summary:
Workers and business owners in Karachi's major industrial zones, including SITE and Korangi, face severe daily challenges due to crumbling roads, traffic gridlocks, and deficient public services. Commuters like Muhammad Ali and Ishtiaq Ali report losing hours navigating broken pavement and congested routes. Industrial transport fleets carrying raw materials and finished goods suffer similar delays, resulting in financial losses through inflated fuel bills and damaged cargo.

Beyond deteriorating roads, businesses grapple with poor sanitation, water shortages, inefficient waste disposal, and failing drainage networks. Industry leaders recently convened to voice concerns over civic mismanagement in Pakistan's commercial capital, which generates approximately 67 percent of federal revenue and 54 percent of national exports. Business representatives highlighted that despite a provincial allocation of over Rs 9 billion approved in December 2025 for urgent repairs, critical infrastructure work remains incomplete or delayed.

Industrialists attribute these persistent problems to institutional incompetence, weak accountability, and administrative failures. While Korangi Industrial Trading Estate CEO Saleemuz Zaman emphasized the urgent need for sewerage upgrades, Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab assured members that allocations would increase in upcoming financial years to support commercial activities and employment.

These infrastructure deficiencies matter because they directly undermine national economic productivity, inflate production costs, and prolong daily commutes for thousands of workers. Timely execution of repair projects and improved administrative coordination remain essential for restoring the viability of Karachi's vital commercial zones.

stories.title: Debutants and Saud Shakeel Power Pakistan to 281-5 Against Sri Lanka
stories.summary:
Pakistan reached 281-5 at stumps on the opening day of the first Test against Sri Lanka at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Monday after the visiting team chose to field first. Saud Shakeel anchored the innings, remaining unbeaten on 57 runs from 112 balls with seven boundaries, alongside wicket-keeper Ghazi Ghori, who was not out on seven before bad light halted play after 67.2 overs.

The hosts included four debutants in their playing XI: Tayyab Arif, Mohammad Taha, Arafat Minhas, and Saqib Khan. Tayyab Arif made an aggressive start alongside opening partner Azan Awais, putting up 86 runs for the first wicket. Azan contributed 30 runs before being caught behind off Milan Rathnayaka. Tayyab went on to score 57 runs from 51 deliveries, featuring nine fours and a single six, before falling to Asitha Fernando.

Mohammad Taha then teamed up with captain Babar Azam to stabilize the innings through a 69-run partnership. Babar departed for 50 runs after being dismissed by Dilshan Madushanka. Taha displayed patience to notch his own fifty, scoring 51 runs off 105 deliveries before being caught by Dhananjaya de Silva off Sonal Dinusha. Saud Shakeel subsequently added partnerships with Salman Ali Agha, who made 16 runs, and Ghazi Ghori to keep the hosts in a strong position.

For Sri Lanka, Asitha Fernando claimed two wickets for 64 runs, while Milan Rathnayaka, Dilshan Madushanka, and Sonal Dinusha picked up one wicket each. Following the day's play, Taha expressed delight over his debut performance, crediting coach Mike Hesson and Babar Azam for their motivation and noting that a total surpassing 400 runs would place heavy pressure on the visiting side on a challenging pitch.

stories.title: امریکہ میں لابنگ فرم کے ذریعے رابطوں کی خبر پر بھارتی سیاست میں تنازع
stories.summary:
امریکہ کی ایک لابنگ فرم کی دستاویزات سامنے آنے کے بعد بھارتی حکومت کو اپوزیشن جماعتوں کی جانب سے سخت تنقید کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا ہے۔ میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق اس فرم نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ اس نے رواں سال مئی اور جون کے دوران بھارتی حکومت اور وائٹ ہاؤس کے اعلیٰ حکام کے درمیان آٹھ فون کالز کے انتظامات میں کردار ادا کیا تھا۔

رپورٹس میں بتایا گیا ہے کہ ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے دوبارہ صدر بننے کے بعد واشنگٹن میں بھارتی سفارت خانے نے مرکری پبلک افیئرز جیسی اہم لابنگ فرموں کی خدمات حاصل کی تھیں، جن میں سے ایک کو 75 ہزار ڈالر ماہانہ کے عوض مقرر کیا گیا تھا۔ اس انکشاف کے بعد کانگریس اور دیگر اپوزیشن رہنماؤں نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ وزیرِ اعظم نریندر مودی کو امریکی صدر سے بات کرنے اور تعریف کروانے کے لیے ٹیکس دہندگان کے پیسوں سے لابنگ فرم کی مدد لینا پڑتی ہے۔

دوسری جانب بھارتی وزارتِ خارجہ کے فیکٹ چیک یونٹ نے اس نوعیت کے دعوؤں کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے انہیں گمراہ کن قرار دیا ہے۔ وزارت کا موقف ہے کہ سفارت خانوں کی جانب سے لابنگ فرموں کی خدمات حاصل کرنا ایک روایتی اور پرانا عمل ہے جو 1948 سے جاری ہے، اور اس کا دوطرفہ تعلقات یا ان رابطوں سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے۔

اس معاملے پر مبصرین اور صحافیوں کی طرف سے بھی مختلف آراء سامنے آئی ہیں، جہاں کچھ ماہرین کا کہنا ہے کہ لابنگ فرمیں عام طور پر کانگریس کے امور میں مدد دیتی ہیں نہ کہ براہِ راست اعلیٰ سرکاری حکام کی بات چیت میں۔ یہ تنازع ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب دونوں ملکوں کے دوطرفہ تعلقات اور سفارتی سرگرمیاں زیرِ بحث ہیں۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Condemns Israeli Restrictions on Gaza Aid
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif expressed deep concern over Israel's ongoing denial of basic humanitarian assistance to the population of Gaza. In a statement posted on social media, he highlighted the severe plight of Palestinian children enduring extreme cold, starvation, and flooded living spaces. He strongly denounced violations of international law, the ceasefire, and continued aggression against the region.

In response to the escalating crisis, Prime Minister Shehbaz directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pursue all available avenues to urgently increase humanitarian assistance for Gaza. This directive follows torrential rains that flooded tens of thousands of makeshift tents housing displaced individuals, washing away shelters and soaking essential bedding.

The Gaza government media office reported that at least 70,000 tents suffered flooding within a 12-hour period, injuring numerous residents. Additionally, the territory's civil defence service logged 1,500 distress calls from displaced civilians, alongside reports of three abandoned structures collapsing without causing casualties.

This situation matters as vulnerable populations in Gaza face compounded hardships from severe weather and restricted aid delivery. The official Pakistani response underscores international calls for immediate humanitarian relief and adherence to international protections for displaced civilians.

stories.title: ٹک ٹاکر مسٹر پتلو سیالکوٹ واقعے میں جاں بحق نوجوان کے لواحقین کو دھمکیاں دینے پر گرفتار
stories.summary:
سیالکوٹ میں پولیس نے مہندی کی تقریب کے دوران مچنے والی بھگدڑ میں جاں بحق ہونے والے نوجوان کے بہنوئی کو مبینہ طور پر دھمکیاں دینے کے الزام میں معروف ٹک ٹاکر انصر جٹ المعروف مسٹر پتلو کو گرفتار کرلیا ہے۔ ایکسپریس نیوز کے مطابق یہ کارروائی تھانہ صدر ڈسکہ میں کی گئی۔

مقدمے کے مدعی اور جاں بحق ہونے والے نوجوان ریحان کے بہنوئی نے مؤقف اختیار کیا ہے کہ ملزم اور اس کے بھائی کاشف بشیر کی جانب سے انہیں اور ان کے اہلخانہ کو قتل کے مقدمے کی پیروی سے روکنے کے لیے دباؤ ڈالا جا رہا ہے۔ مدعی کے مطابق نامزد ملزمان کی جانب سے انہیں سنگین نتائج کی دھمکیاں دی گئیں تاکہ وہ عدالت میں کارروائی آگے نہ بڑھائیں۔

پولیس نے مدعی کی تحریری درخواست پر فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ایف آئی آر درج کی اور ٹک ٹاکر کو حراست میں لے لیا۔ پولیس کے مطابق مسٹر پتلو پہلے ہی اس واقعے سے متعلق مختلف دفعات کے تحت درج مقدمے میں عبوری ضمانت پر چل رہے تھے، جن میں اب دھمکیوں کا نیا الزام بھی شامل کر لیا گیا ہے۔

اس نئے مقدمے کے بعد قانونی پیچیدگیاں مزید بڑھ گئی ہیں جبکہ تفتیشی ٹیم نے معاملے کی مزید تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے۔ حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ قانون کے مطابق تمام شواہد کا جائزہ لے کر کارروائی کو آگے بڑھایا جائے گا۔

stories.title: کراچی: گاجروں کی آڑ میں 23 کروڑ روپے کی منشیات اسمگل کرنے کی کوشش ناکام
stories.summary:
پاکستان کسٹمز انفورسمنٹ نے انسداد اسمگلنگ مہم کے دوران ایک بڑی کارروائی کرتے ہوئے بلوچستان سے کراچی منشیات اسمگل کرنے کی کوشش ناکام بنا دی ہے۔ حکام کے مطابق آر سی ڈی ہائی وے پر کی جانے والی اس کارروائی کے دوران ایک مزدا ٹرک سے 51 کلوگرام چرس برآمد کی گئی۔

کسٹمز حکام نے بتایا کہ یہ منشیات مزدا ٹرک کے خفیہ خانوں میں گاجروں کی آڑ چھپا کر لائی جا رہی تھی، جس کی بین الاقوامی مالیت تقریباً 23 کروڑ 95 لاکھ روپے بنتی ہے۔ ابتدائی تحقیقات سے یہ بات سامنے آئی ہے کہ مذکورہ مزدا ٹرک (رجسٹریشن نمبر ٹی کے ٹی 358) کے ذریعے یہ منشیات بلوچستان کے علاقے گلستان سے کراچی منتقل کی جا رہی تھی۔

کارروائی کے دوران موقع پر ہی مزدا ٹرک کے ڈرائیور محمد قاسم کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا جس کا تعلق قلعہ عبداللہ سے ہے۔ کسٹمز حکام نے برآمد شدہ چرس اور ٹرک کو اپنی تحویل میں لے کر ضبط کر لیا ہے اور باضابطہ طور پر مقدمہ درج کر کے تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے۔

حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ اس بڑے اسمگلنگ نیٹ ورک کے مالی معاونین، سہولت کاروں اور کراچی میں منشیات کے ممکنہ وصول کنندگان کا سراغ لگانے کے لیے مزید تحقیقات کا دائرہ وسیع کر دیا گیا ہے تاکہ اس گھناؤنے کاروبار میں ملوث تمام عناصر کو قانون کے کٹہرے میں لایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: AI Power Surge Drives High Demand for Used Gas Turbines
stories.summary:
Utilities, developers, and energy firms powering artificial intelligence data centres are increasingly turning to second-hand gas turbines, refurbished machines, and converted jet engines. This trend is driven by severe supply bottlenecks, as delivery windows for new equipment stretch into the 2030 to 2031 timeframe. Aurora Tenorio, a senior analyst at Wood Mackenzie, noted that US turbine delivery times now average six years. While global manufacturing capacity is expanding, it falls significantly short of the soaring demand.

To bypass lengthy backlogs, companies are actively scouring a secondary market described by industry leaders as very hot, leading to escalating prices. EthosEnergy CEO Ana Amicarella and Sulzer aftermarket leader Darayus Pardivala both highlighted the heavy influx of requests for used units. According to Zach Machuca of Origin Partners, well-maintained used units sell for approximately $1.5 million to $1.7 million per megawatt, while refurbished units cost around $1.3 million. These figures compare favourably to new turbines priced between $2 million and $2.5 million per megawatt, though some smaller units have traded at even steeper discounts.

Despite the cost and time savings, relying on second-hand equipment introduces distinct challenges. Analysts point out that overhauled turbines often feature unclear maintenance histories, limited remaining lifespan, and weak long-term servicing. Furthermore, converted jet engines raise questions regarding their suitability for continuous power generation. Additional hurdles, such as air permits and grid access, also contribute to project delays.

The unprecedented demand from data centres has impacted players across the broader energy sector, causing price surges for all types of equipment. Non-profit utilities and organizations like the National Rural Electric Cooperative Association report facing unprecedented lead times. Consequently, some developers are exploring alternatives, such as gas engines offered by Finland's Wartsila, which has secured substantial orders from US data centres to mitigate power supply constraints.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Orders Urgent Humanitarian Assistance for Rain-Hit Gaza
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced on Monday that he has directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to pursue all possible means to urgently escalate humanitarian assistance to Gaza. The directive follows heavy rains that lashed the region, flooding tens of thousands of tents housing displaced Palestinians. According to the Gaza government media office, at least 70,000 tents were flooded within a 12-hour period, displacing thousands, causing injuries, and washing away vulnerable shelters.

Gaza's civil defence service reported receiving 1,500 distress calls from affected residents. Municipal and civil defence officials stated they were unable to manage the storm due to severe fuel shortages and extensive equipment damage, noting that Israel had destroyed hundreds of vehicles, including bulldozers and water-pumping trucks, during its military assault. Prime Minister Shehbaz described photos from Gaza as heart-rending, highlighting that children were trapped, starving, and subjected to extreme cold with nowhere to go.

The prime minister expressed deep concern over ongoing Israeli actions denying basic humanitarian aid to the Palestinian people. He strongly condemned these violations of the ceasefire and international law, alongside continued aggression in the territory. Since the escalation following the October 7, 2023, attack by Hamas, Palestinian authorities report that over 74,000 people have been killed in Gaza, where the majority of the population relies on aid supplies amid severe restrictions.

Residents across Gaza encampments struggled to cope with the deluge, using sand to reinforce shelters and sweeping away rainwater from flooded bedding and floors. Displaced individuals reported lacking basic resources, tarpaulins, and dry sleeping spaces. Despite a US-brokered ceasefire agreement last year that called for reconstruction, little progress has been made, with Israeli forces maintaining control over significant portions of the territory and conducting frequent airstrikes.

stories.title: Lahore Tops Global Pollution Rankings as Smog and AQI Exceed 600
stories.summary:
Lahore was ranked the world's most polluted major city on Monday, with its Air Quality Index reaching 590 according to IQAir, while historical platform readings recorded an hourly index of 647 in the hazardous category. The city's pollution level was more than three times higher than the second-ranked city. Within Lahore, severe air quality was recorded across multiple neighbourhoods, including Allama Iqbal Town with an AQI of 1,033, the CERP Office at 864, and Burki Road Paragon at 748. The crisis has also affected other parts of Punjab, with hazardous readings reported in Raiwind, Multan, and Faisalabad.

The severe deterioration in air quality arrived a day after the Punjab government warned that smoke from Diwali fireworks in neighbouring Indian Punjab, combined with crop-residue burning and easterly winds, would aggravate pollution. A provincial government report noted that 2,347 agricultural fire incidents had been recorded in Indian Punjab up to November 4, with nearly half located in border districts opposite Lahore and Kasur. However, satellite data from NASA's VIIRS analyzed by Hamari Hawa showed significantly higher fire detections on the Pakistani side of the border between October 1 and 29, indicating extensive domestic agricultural burning as well.

Air pollution remains a major global health risk, ranking as the second-leading risk factor for deaths worldwide and claiming approximately 8.1 million lives annually, with outdoor particulate matter accounting for 4.7 million of those deaths. In response to the crisis in Lahore, the Punjab Environment Protection Agency reported deploying specialized night squads, drones, and fire-fighting units to crack down on stubble burning. The Punjab Climate Watch Hub has been actively utilizing satellite anomaly detection to identify vulnerable locations for on-ground verification.

The provincial government expects pollution levels to remain elevated before seeing a slight improvement. The Environment Protection Department plans to release comparative findings to assess the distinct contributions of cross-border sources, local emissions, and weather conditions to the persistent smog enveloping the region.

stories.title: Durefishan Saleem Defends Character's Modesty Choices Amid Public Debate
stories.summary:
Actor Durefishan Saleem has urged audiences to respect the clothing choices of her character Zaryab in the television drama 'Dar-e-Nijaat', following online discussions sparked by a recent episode. In the scene, Zaryab declines a sleeveless outfit for a family gathering, stating she is no longer comfortable dressing that way, which drew mixed reactions regarding her evolving relationship with faith.

Taking to Instagram, Saleem clarified that the character's choice was an internal personal journey and was not imposed by her husband Abu Bakr, played by Sheheryar Munawar. She emphasized that spirituality represents an internal transformation that can eventually reflect in external decisions like modesty, but stressed that one person's approach does not invalidate another's.

Saleem noted that she personally wears sleeveless clothing and feels comfortable doing so, pointing out that different people maintain different personal relationships with modesty. She argued that a woman's freedom to choose her attire must extend in every direction, meaning neither a woman who dresses freely nor one who chooses modesty should have to justify herself or face public judgment.

Created by writer Umera Ahmed and director Saqib Khan, the series explores themes of faith, personal transformation, and relationships. Saleem concluded by suggesting that viewers do not need to turn every fictional character's personal narrative into a national referendum or a subject for internet verdicts, emphasizing that stories can simply be enjoyed as someone else's journey.

stories.title: شمالی وزیرستان کے علاقے میر علی میں سیکیورٹی فورسز کا کامیاب انٹیلی جنس آپریشن
stories.summary:
پاکستان کی سیکیورٹی فورسز نے شمالی وزیرستان کے علاقے میر علی کے گاؤں موزاک میں ایک انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشن کیا ہے۔ پاک فوج کے شعبۂ تعلقاتِ عامہ (آئی ایس پی آر) کے مطابق اس کارروائی کے دوران فتنہ الخوارج کی جانب سے مساجد میں قائم کیے گئے دو اہم ٹھکانوں کو مکمل طور پر کلیئر کرایا گیا۔

آئی ایس پی آر نے بتایا کہ دہشت گردوں نے ان مساجد کو دھماکا خیز مواد ذخیرہ کرنے اور ٹارچر سیل چلانے کے لیے استعمال کیا۔ سیکیورٹی فورسز نے اس کارروائی میں بھاری مقدار میں اسلحہ، گولہ بارود اور آئی ای ڈیز برآمد کی ہیں، جن میں مجموعی طور پر 2.9 ٹن دھماکا خیز مواد بھی شامل ہے۔

فوج کے ترجمان کا کہنا ہے کہ مساجد جیسے مقدسات کا اس طرح کا استعمال اسلام کی بنیادی تعلیمات سے کھلی بے پرواہی اور غفلت کا ثبوت ہے۔ حکام کے مطابق افغان طالبان کی پشت پناہی سے چلنے والے ان خارجی عناصر کا اسلام سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے، اور ان کی جانب سے مذہب کا غلط استعمال کسی صورت قابلِ قبول نہیں ہے۔

علاقے میں امن و امان کی بحالی کے لیے سیکیورٹی فورسز کا کلیئرنس آپریشن تاحال جاری ہے۔ خیبر پختونخوا سمیت پورے ملک کے غیور عوام نے دہشت گردوں کی ان مذموم کارروائیوں اور مساجد کے تقدس پامال کرنے کے عمل کو سختی سے مسترد کر دیا ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی: نانا کے ساتھ موٹرسائیکل پر جاتے ہوئے پتنگ کی ڈور سے بچی جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے لیاقت آباد میں ایک دلخراش واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں نانا کے ساتھ موٹرسائیکل پر سوار ہو کر جانے والی کمسن بچی گلے پر پتنگ کی ڈور پھرنے کے باعث موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئی۔ متوفی بچی کے نانا نذیر نے میڈیا کو بتایا کہ خطرناک پتنگ کی ڈور پہلے ان کے اپنے ہاتھ پر لگی اور پھر فوری بعد بچی کے گلے پر پھر گئی، جس سے شدید نقصان پہنچا۔

نانا نذیر کے مطابق وہ زخمی بچی کو فوری طور پر اسپتال لے کر جا رہے تھے لیکن وہ راستے میں ہی ایمبولینس کے اندر دم توڑ گئی۔ انہوں نے مزید بتایا کہ وہ اس واقعے پر کسی کے خلاف کوئی قانونی کارروائی کرنے کا ارادہ نہیں رکھتے، تاہم انہوں نے پتنگ اڑانے والوں سے انتہائی پرزور اپیل کی ہے کہ وہ اس جان لیوا کھیل کو کھیلنا چھوڑ دیں کیونکہ آج ان کی بچی گئی ہے اور کل کسی اور کے ساتھ بھی یہ المیہ پیش آ سکتا ہے۔

stories.title: Ramla Ali Claims First World Boxing Title in Texas
stories.summary:
British-Somali boxer Ramla Ali secured her first world title at the age of 37 via a split-decision victory over American Mikiah Kreps in Arlington, Texas. Ali claimed the vacant WBO and IBF junior featherweight championship belts on Sunday despite being outlanded overall and trailing significantly in power punches throughout the bout.

Ali's victory came after she knocked Kreps down with a right hook in the third round. Although Kreps responded strongly and landed more shots in eight of the ten rounds, two judges scored the contest 97-92 and 96-93 in favor of Ali, overriding a third judge's scorecard of 98-91 for Kreps.

Ali's athletic journey includes settling in London as a refugee after escaping the civil war in Somalia with her family. She previously made history by becoming the first Somali boxer to compete at the Olympic Games at Tokyo 2020, and later became the first Muslim woman to win an English amateur boxing title.

stories.title: Pakistan International Airlines Launches Fleet-Wide Deep-Cleaning Initiative
stories.summary:
Pakistan International Airlines has initiated a thorough cleaning campaign across its aircraft fleet in order to elevate cabin cleanliness and overall maintenance standards. The carrier carried out specialized cabin inspections and cleaning procedures at airports located in Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad.

Adrian Hamilton-Manns, the newly appointed Chief Executive Officer of the airline, stressed that maintaining aircraft cleanliness is exceptionally crucial for upholding the highest standards of the company's brand. He noted that keeping the fleet in top-tier condition represents a primary focus and serves as the foundation for an ongoing process to secure optimal aircraft quality.

To acknowledge outstanding contributions toward the project, the airline recognized participating workers by distributing shields, certificates, and cash prizes. This operational drive follows shortly after Hamilton-Manns officially took charge as CEO, bringing over three decades of commercial aviation experience that includes prior leadership positions at three separate airlines in Africa, Kazakhstan, and Oman.

The restructuring expert is tasked with enhancing service quality levels and reinforcing the national carrier's standing within the global aviation sector. This early step highlights management's dedication to implementing operational reforms and sustaining elevated benchmarks for passenger service and hygiene.

stories.title: اٹلی کے قدیم شہر پومپئی سے دو ہزار سال پرانی پرفیوم شیشی دریافت
stories.summary:
اٹلی کے قدیم اور تاریخی شہر پومپئی کے کھنڈرات میں ماہرینِ آثارِ قدیمہ نے کھدائی کے دوران ایک الماری سے لگ بھگ دو ہزار سال پرانی پرفیوم کی ایک نایاب شیشی سمیت متعدد قدیم نوادرات دریافت کیے ہیں۔ اس حیرت انگیز دریافت نے محققین کو قدیم رومی تہذیب کے بارے میں مزید جاننے کا موقع فراہم کیا ہے۔

ماہرین کے مطابق یہ نوادرات شہر کے علاقے ریجیو 9 میں واقع ایک مکان کے پچھلے حصے سے ملنے والی الماری سے برآمد ہوئے۔ پرفیوم کی شیشی کے علاوہ اس الماری سے بچوں کے ہار، کانسی کے 38 سِکّے، سیسے کے باٹ اور مختلف آرائشی اشیا بھی ملی ہیں۔ تاریخی حوالوں سے اس مکان کو کارنیلیئس میکسیمس نامی شخص سے منسوب کیا جاتا ہے، تاہم الماری پر موجود تحریری نقوش اب مدہم ہو چکے ہیں۔

تاریخی پس منظر کے مطابق پومپئی کا یہ پورا شہر 79 عیسوی میں قریبی ویسوویئس آتش فشاں کے خوفناک پھٹنے کے بعد لاوے اور راکھ کی تہوں تلے دب گیا تھا، جس کی وجہ سے اس دور کی زندگی اور املاک کے آثار آج تک محفوظ حالت میں ملتے ہیں۔ محققین کا کہنا ہے کہ آتش فشاں پھٹنے کے وقت یہ مکان ممکنہ طور پر مرمت اور تزئین و آرائش کے مرحلے میں تھا کیونکہ چھت پر سادہ پلستر موجود تھا اور آرائشی کام نہیں کیا گیا تھا۔

ماہرین نے کھنڈرات سے ملنے والے نشانات کی مدد سے اس الماری کو دوبارہ اس کی اصل شکل میں تیار کیا ہے۔ صدیوں سے جاری ان سائنسی کھدائیوں کے نتیجے میں پومپئی کا تقریباً دو تہائی حصہ اب تک سامنے لایا جا چکا ہے، جس سے قدیم رومیوں کے روزمرہ معمولات اور رہن سہن کی عکاسی ہوتی ہے۔

stories.title: South African Rand Rises as Global Oil Prices Soften
stories.summary:
The South African rand experienced an upward movement during early trading sessions, appreciating against the dollar as declining oil prices helped alleviate domestic inflation anxieties. Market participants simultaneously evaluated the outcomes of recent local municipal elections alongside ongoing discussions surrounding coalition governments.

Trading activity positioned the currency approximately 0.4 percent stronger than its previous close. Meanwhile, global oil prices stabilized following comments from US President Donald Trump indicating that new military actions against Iran remained unlikely, though lingering supply disruptions persisted after vessels near the Strait of Hormuz faced attacks.

Because South Africa functions as a net importer of fuel, the nation remains vulnerable to shifts in international crude prices, which can directly push up local fuel expenses, fuel inflation, and weaken the rand. Political uncertainty also weighed on the outlook, as the African National Congress faced notable setbacks in local municipal polls, complicating upcoming coalition negotiations for city administrations.

Analysts at ETM Analytics observed that overall risk balances continue to lean against the local currency, with investors monitoring offshore equity markets to gauge global risk appetite. Furthermore, the country's benchmark 2035 government bond remained unchanged in early deals, maintaining a yield of 8.3 percent as the political and economic landscape continues to navigate these complex variables.

stories.title: Greek Coast Guard Recovers Twelve Bodies from Boat Near Crete
stories.summary:
Greek authorities successfully retrieved the bodies of 12 deceased individuals and rescued 18 survivors from a vessel operating near the island of Crete. Officials stated that the exact cause of death for the deceased migrants remains undetermined at this time.

The rescue operation took place roughly 15 nautical miles away from the port of Kaloi Limenes. Coast guard personnel also intercepted and aided dozens of additional people across two separate incidents near Crete, with all survivors scheduled to be brought safely ashore.

Historically serving as a primary entry point to Europe for refugees and migrants originating from Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, Greece stood at the center of the 2015-2016 European migration crisis when nearly one million individuals arrived on its shores, primarily traveling through Turkey. Although total arrivals dropped significantly after Athens strengthened both sea and border patrols, recent months have witnessed an uptick in sea arrivals originating from northeastern Libya as migrants attempt dangerous journeys toward Europe via Crete.

stories.title: Ousted Bangladeshi Leader Seeks New Passport Ahead of Return
stories.summary:
Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has formally requested a new passport and national identity card through her legal representation, signaling her intent to travel back from India where she has lived in self-imposed exile. The communication marks her first formal outreach since fleeing the country during a deadly uprising in 2024 that dismantled her extended tenure in power.

Lawyers representing the former leader at London-based Matrix Chambers submitted the application to Preeti Rahman, acting high commissioner at the diplomatic mission in New Delhi, urging expedited processing based on her nationality and international human rights obligations. The interim administration in Dhaka had previously revoked her travel documents and identity card following her departure.

Hasina was sentenced to death in absentia last November by a war-crimes court over her role in cracking down on student-led protests, accusations she has consistently rejected from abroad. Her legal team and aides indicated that a precise return date to face the court will be finalized once administrative formalities conclude, despite her political party, the Awami League, currently facing an official ban.

Her potential return carries the risk of intensifying political and legal divisions within Bangladesh as current leadership endeavors to stabilize the nation following years of turbulence. At the same time, her repatriation could potentially mend diplomatic relations between Dhaka and New Delhi, which suffered considerable strain after India granted her sanctuary.

stories.title: Krakow Mass Shooting Gunman Dies in Hospital, Police Confirm
stories.summary:
A young assailant responsible for killing six individuals in central Krakow passed away in the hospital early on Monday, according to law enforcement officials. The incident marked an unprecedented mass shooting event in Poland, unfolding when the 24-year-old opened fire on pedestrians from his vehicle at the historic main square. Authorities swiftly shot and apprehended the suspect just minutes after the attack commenced.

The perpetrator originated from Ostrowiec Swietokrzyski, a southeastern Polish community housing just under 60,000 residents. Government representatives indicated that the shooter might have drawn motivation from far-right ideology, though officials noted that further details remain forthcoming as inquiries continue.

Karolina Galecka, a spokeswoman for the interior ministry, addressed the media on Monday via radio station TOK FM regarding the physical evidence gathered from the scene. She stated that investigators are currently analyzing and interpreting multiple emblems discovered on the perpetrator's clothing.

While specialists review these various motif patches associated with the suspect's attire, officials have declined to offer additional comments. The broader investigation into the shooting and the underlying motives remains active as the nation processes the shock of the tragedy.

stories.title: US military prepares for international stabilization force deployment near Gaza border
stories.summary:
Preparations are underway by the United States military near the Gaza Strip border to facilitate the deployment of an international stabilization force inside the Palestinian enclave. Israeli media reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government granted the US approval for an initial deployment of approximately 250 foreign personnel. Countries including Indonesia, Morocco, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Uganda, and Albania have expressed willingness to participate, offering medical, logistical, and security assistance.

This proposed initiative forms part of US President Donald Trump’s plan for Gaza, which has faced severe destruction and high casualties following the outbreak of conflict in October 2023. Israeli security officials expressed apprehension regarding potential shifts in US policy and the rapid speed at which foreign troops could arrive, noting that an international contingent might outsize the local Israeli Gaza Division. Consequently, an Israeli military base in the south has been converted into a heavily fortified US facility featuring guard towers, lighting, reinforced perimeter fencing, and round-the-clock security provided by armed American soldiers.

Additionally, engineering work is progressing on a United Arab Emirates-backed project in Rafah to construct a new city designed to house tens of thousands of displaced Palestinians following strict security screenings. The international stabilization force is expected to secure this pilot project area during its initial phase. Meanwhile, the broader humanitarian situation in Gaza remains catastrophic, with extensive infrastructure destruction, continued restrictions on vital aid supplies, and ongoing casualties despite a ceasefire that took effect on October 10, 2025.

stories.title: Analysts React as Nvidia Board Investigates CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary:
The board of Nvidia has initiated an inquiry into CEO Jensen Huang following media reports suggesting he was the target of a foreign intelligence operation orchestrated via a Chinese businesswoman who allegedly relayed information to Beijing. Industry experts and financial figures have subsequently offered divergent perspectives on the potential fallout for the world's second most valuable corporation.

Ryu Young-Ho, a senior analyst at NH Investment & Securities, suggested that the United States government has likely known about the situation for several months, mitigating immediate market impacts. However, he warned that extended internal reviews could jeopardize Nvidia's investment timelines and product schedules, carrying wider consequences for the semiconductor sector.

Conversely, Tesla investor Gary Black expressed skepticism regarding Huang's ability to retain his position, noting the absence of a natural internal successor. Black predicted that governance questions and conduct scrutiny will prompt numerous portfolio managers to trim their Nvidia shareholdings amid leadership uncertainty, placing temporary pressure on the stock.

Other public figures and market observers offered mixed commentary regarding the sensitive nature of the allegations. While some emphasized Huang's monumental contributions to the artificial intelligence landscape and voiced hope that the situation involves a simple personal affair rather than a national security threat, others stressed that the timing poses severe complications for tech markets and broader economic stability as upcoming earnings reports approach.

stories.title: Nvidia Shares Slip in After-Hours Trading Amid CEO Investigation
stories.summary:
Nvidia shares experienced a decline of approximately 3.4% during out-of-hours trading, settling near $180.30 following revelations that the chipmaker's board is investigating CEO Jensen Huang. The internal probe was launched after reports emerged indicating Huang maintained a relationship with Alice Huang, an unrelated former executive of Singapore-based Megaspeed who US authorities determined was a Chinese intelligence asset.

In response to the developments, Huang acknowledged to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife. The scrutiny surrounding the world's most valuable chipmaker also affected executive travel plans, leading Madison Huang, the CEO's daughter and an Nvidia official, to cancel a scheduled visit to Seoul for an upcoming industry conference.

Prominent figures across finance and politics offered varied reactions to the unfolding situation. Billionaire investor Bill Ackman noted on social media that the allegations present a serious problem if proven to go beyond a personal affair, while Tesla CEO Elon Musk echoed sentiments regarding Huang's irreplaceable role in American AI leadership. US President Donald Trump stated he had not spoken with Huang directly but described him as an honorable person who likely has an explanation.

Market analysts suggested that while the boardroom turbulence creates uncertainty, the long-term impact on the artificial intelligence sector will depend heavily on whether leadership changes occur. Meanwhile, shares in key Asian semiconductor suppliers such as TSMC, Samsung Electronics, and SK Hynix rebounded during Monday trading following earlier market selloffs.

stories.title: توحید ہردوئے کی شاندار اننگز، سلہٹ ٹیسٹ ڈرا، ویسٹ انڈیز نے سیریز جیت لی
stories.summary:
بنگلادیش اور ویسٹ انڈیز کے درمیان کھیلا جانے والا سلہٹ ٹیسٹ میچ خراب روشنی کی وجہ سے کھیل کے آخری روز ڈرا ہو گیا، جس کا باضابطہ خاتمہ مقامی وقت کے مطابق شام چار بجے ہوا۔ مئی 2022 کے بعد بنگلادیش میں یہ پہلا ٹیسٹ میچ ہے جو کسی نتیجے کے بغیر ختم ہوا ہے، کیونکہ اس طویل عرصے میں میزبان ٹیم نے مسلسل اٹھارہ ٹیسٹ بغیر کسی ڈرا کے کھیلے تھے۔

بنگلادیش کو ہار سے بچانے میں بیٹر توحید ہردوئے نے مرکزی کردار ادا کیا، جنہوں نے چوتھی اننگز میں 82 رنز کی شاندار باری کھیلی۔ اس سے قبل وہ سلہٹ ٹیسٹ کی پہلی اننگز میں ناقابلِ شکست 242 رنز بھی بنا چکے تھے۔ اس شاندار کارکردگی کے ساتھ توحید ہردوئے ایک ہی ٹیسٹ میچ میں مجموعی طور پر 300 سے زائد رنز بنانے والے پہلے بنگلادیشی اور دنیا کے نویں بیٹر بن گئے ہیں۔ انہوں نے مومن الحق کا 2018 کا ریکارڈ توڑا۔

اگرچہ سلہٹ ٹیسٹ ڈرا ہو گیا، لیکن مہمان ٹیم ویسٹ انڈیز نے میرپور کا پہلا ٹیسٹ آٹھ وکٹوں سے جیت رکھا تھا، جس کی بدولت اس نے دو میچوں کی یہ ٹیسٹ سیریز 0-1 سے اپنے نام کر لی۔ اس کامیابی کے ساتھ ویسٹ انڈیز نے 2021 کے بعد مسلسل دوسری بار بنگلادیش میں ٹیسٹ سیریز جیتی ہے اور اپنا ورلڈ ٹیسٹ چیمپیئن شپ کا سائیکل بھی کامیابی سے مکمل کیا ہے۔ دوسری جانب بنگلادیشی ٹیم کو اب 15 نومبر سے جوہانسبرگ میں شروع ہونے والے اگلے ٹیسٹ کی تیاری کے لیے صرف پانچ دن ملے ہیں۔

stories.title: Coco Gauff Outlasts Jessica Pegula in Thrilling WTA Finals Opener
stories.summary:
Coco Gauff secured a hard-fought victory over compatriot Jessica Pegula with a score of 6-4, 6-7(5), 6-2 during the opening day of the WTA Finals at Indian Wells on Sunday. In another match on the tournament's first day, Czech newcomer Linda Noskova defeated Marta Kostyuk 6-2, 6-4 to start her campaign strongly.

The encounter between Gauff and Pegula showcased high versatility and intense baseline rallies from the top two American players in the season-ending tournament. After Gauff claimed a tight opening set, Pegula seized momentum by winning the initial three games of the second set. Gauff fought back by saving multiple set points before Pegula ultimately claimed the second-set tiebreak.

Gauff regained control in the deciding third set, establishing a 5-2 lead before closing out the match on her third match point. Following the contest, Gauff noted that she competed with minimal preparation after a month-long break since the China Open, adding that the physical demands of the match completely tore up her tennis shoes.

In the day's other match, the eighth-ranked Linda Noskova applied consistent pressure from the baseline and net to overcome Kostyuk. Kostyuk entered the competition late as a replacement for top-ranked Elena Rybakina but struggled to find her rhythm against Noskova, who delivered 20 winners to seal the victory.

stories.title: China extends trade truce with the United States by two months
stories.summary:
China announced an effective two-month extension of its ongoing trade truce with the United States by continuing the suspension of several key trade measures. The previous truce was scheduled to expire, coinciding with preparations for an upcoming meeting between Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump at the APEC leaders' summit. The decision follows a previous summit in Washington where both nations proposed reciprocal tariff cuts and trade adjustments.

Under the newly announced measures, China's state council confirmed that a 24% additional tariff on certain US imports will remain suspended for two months, while a 10% tariff stays in place. Furthermore, the Chinese commerce ministry extended export-control waivers for critical minerals and related technologies through January 10, 2027. Similar extensions through early 2027 apply to measures affecting specific US firms on China's unreliable entities and export control lists, as well as port fee suspensions for US-linked vessels and related supply chain probes. The commerce ministry also prolonged the suspension of sanctions targeting five Hanwha Ocean units.

The Chinese tariffs commission stated that these actions are intended to implement the consensus reached during the presidential meeting in Washington. Officials noted that Beijing is closely monitoring Washington's intent to substitute invalidated emergency economic powers tariffs with Section 301 tariffs, indicating that countermeasures will be adjusted if necessary depending on future developments.

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz Wins Paris Masters and Sets Sights on ATP Finals
stories.summary:
World number three Carlos Alcaraz captured his fifth title of the year by winning the Paris Masters on Sunday. He defeated American player Ben Shelton with scores of 7-6(5) and 7-5. The victory marked his third title since returning to the tour at the US Open following a nearly five-month break due to a wrist injury.

The seven-time Grand Slam champion stated that this was his best week of tennis since his return. He noted that he made a significant mental step forward during the tournament by overcoming difficult internal moments, managing his thoughts, and staying positive throughout his matches.

Alcaraz has never won the ATP Tour's season-ending tournament, having finished as runner-up in 2025 after a defeat against rival Jannik Sinner. Despite uncertainty about whether he will secure the trophy this year, he expressed a strong desire to win the event eventually and is heading into the tournament with high confidence.

The upcoming ATP Finals are scheduled to begin on Sunday in Turin. Alcaraz plans to use the information and experience gained in Paris to improve his performance during the prestigious season-ending competition.

stories.title: Australia Drops Marnus Labuschagne for Upcoming New Zealand Test Series
stories.summary:
Cricket Australia has dropped 32-year-old batter Marnus Labuschagne from the Test squad for the upcoming four-test home series against New Zealand. Selector George Bailey confirmed the decision on Monday, explaining that the move aims to give the player space following a prolonged slump in form and heavy speculation surrounding his position.

Labuschagne, once ranked as the world's top test batter, has gone 49 innings without scoring a century. During a recent tour of South Africa, where Australia lost the series 2-1, he recorded scores of zero and four in the final test. Since being dropped during the tour of the West Indies last year, he has averaged 23.66 and managed only two half-centuries across 10 tests.

While out of the national team, Labuschagne will return to captain Queensland in the Sheffield Shield. Selectors will evaluate potential top-order replacements ahead of the series opener in Perth on December 9, while leaving open the possibility that Labuschagne could regain his spot for future tours of India and England.

His omission creates further instability for Australia's top order, which has experienced constant changes since opening batsman David Warner retired nearly three years ago. Potential replacements and lineup adjustments are being considered, with the final squad to be determined after the next round of Shield matches.

stories.title: Pakistan Celebrates Iqbal Day and Launches Year-Long 150th Birth Anniversary Commemorations
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif paid tribute to Allama Muhammad Iqbal, known as the Poet of the East, on Iqbal Day and the 149th anniversary of his birth. In his message, the Prime Minister highlighted Iqbal's role in awakening political consciousness among Muslims in the Subcontinent and inspiring the struggle for an independent homeland.

The Prime Minister praised Iqbal's intellectual stature, wisdom, and contributions to Islamic thought, noting that his philosophy continues to guide individuals and societies. He emphasized concepts such as 'Khudi' for self-realization and the 'Shaheen' falcon as a symbol of courage and high aspirations, while stressing that Iqbal's teachings reject extremism and promote peace, tolerance, and human unity.

To mark the occasion, the government announced the beginning of a year-long commemoration leading up to Iqbal's 150th birth anniversary on November 9 of next year. A comprehensive schedule of national and international events has been launched, featuring academic conferences, literary festivals, research seminars, educational competitions, and cultural exhibitions.

These initiatives are designed to preserve Iqbal's intellectual legacy and integrate his principles into educational institutions and national development priorities. The government aims to encourage scholarly research, foster creative thinking, and strengthen national character by engaging the country's youth with the philosopher's timeless message.

stories.title: Rawalpindi Court Remands Husband of Slain Anchorperson Rabia Ahsan in Police Custody
stories.summary:
A Rawalpindi court on Monday granted a one-day physical remand for Ahsan Tahir, the husband of television journalist and anchorperson Rabia Ahsan, following her fatal shooting at their home. The 41-year-old anchorperson, associated with 92 News, was found dead on Sunday, triggering widespread grief across the journalist community. Police had requested a seven-day remand to interrogate the suspect.

The case was registered at the Sadar Bairuni police station following a complaint filed by Rabia's brother, Khurram Ahmed. According to the First Information Report, the incident occurred at the couple's home in Gulshanabad Sector II on Adiala Road. Rabia's mother and sister reported hearing a gunshot from a bedroom around 2:30 pm on Sunday while they were outside in the lawn. Her sister rushed indoors to find Rabia lying in a pool of blood with Ahsan holding a pistol.

Authorities stated that Ahsan admitted to firing the weapon at his wife during the incident, though he failed to produce a valid license or permit for the firearm. The case was registered under Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code alongside Section 13(2)(a) of the Punjab Arms Amendment Ordinance. Police sources identified the suspect as a grade-18 officer at the Overseas Pakistanis Foundation.

Investigators from the Punjab Forensic Science Agency gathered evidence from the crime scene, and Rabia's body was transferred to a hospital for a post-mortem examination. Surviving her are two daughters, and she also managed a private salon in Islamabad. The court instructed police to produce the suspect again on Tuesday.

stories.title: Passenger Train Collision in Egypt Leaves Seven Dead and Dozens Injured
stories.summary:
A passenger train collision occurred approximately 76 kilometers south of Cairo on Sunday, resulting in at least seven deaths and 112 injuries. According to Egypt's health ministry, the accident took place when a train traveling from Giza to Fayoum struck the rear of another train heading from Cairo to Aswan, causing several carriages to derail.

The state railway authority dispatched emergency crews to clear the wreckage and restore services along the Cairo-Upper Egypt line, though no timeline was provided for the resumption of normal operations. Egypt's public prosecutor’s office initiated investigations to identify the technical causes behind the crash on the railway network.

Following the incident, President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ordered a swift investigation and stated that any individuals found negligent must be held accountable. The country operates one of the oldest and largest railway networks in the region, where accidents involving casualties have frequently occurred despite government investments of billions of Egyptian pounds to modernize infrastructure.

Historically, Egypt's railway system has experienced severe accidents, including the country's worst-ever rail disaster in 2002 when a fire swept through seven carriages of an overcrowded passenger service, resulting in at least 360 fatalities.

stories.title: اسلام آباد ایئرپورٹ پر مشکوک ویزے پر ترکیہ جانے والا مسافر آف لوڈ
stories.summary:
ایف آئی اے امیگریشن نے اسلام آباد انٹرنیشنل ایئرپورٹ پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ترکیہ جانے والے ایک مسافر کو مشکوک سفری دستاویزات اور ویزے کے غلط استعمال کے شبہے میں پرواز سے آف لوڈ کر دیا۔ مسافر پرواز نمبر QR-615 کے ذریعے ترکیہ روانہ ہو رہا تھا، لیکن پروفائلنگ کے دوران اس کے سفری مقصد اور دستاویزات میں تضادات پائے گئے۔

تفتیش کے دوران انکشاف ہوا کہ مسافر نے گیارہ لاکھ پچاس ہزار روپے دے کر ایک ایجنٹ سے این جی او یا کاپ 31 ویزا حاصل کیا تھا۔ ایجنٹ نے اسے یقین دلایا تھا کہ اس ویزے پر ترکیہ میں ملازمت کی جا سکتی ہے، حالانکہ مسافر اس این جی او کا رکن نہیں تھا اور یہ ویزے کی شرائط کے منافی تھا۔

موبাইল فون اور واٹس ایپ چیٹس کے تجزیے سے ایجنٹ کے ساتھ روابط اور ویزے کے غلط استعمال کے منصوبے کے شواہد سامنے آئے۔ تحقیقات میں یہ بات بھی سامنے آئی کہ ایجنٹ نے مسافر کو امیگریشن کلیئرنس کے لیے ایف آئی اے افسران کو ڈیڑھ لاکھ روپے رشوت دینے کی ہدایت کی تھی۔

مسافر ترکیہ جانے کا کوئی تسلی بخش جواز فراہم نہیں کر سکا۔ آف لوڈ کرنے کے بعد ایف آئی اے نے اسے مزید قانونی کارروائی اور تفتیش کے لیے اینٹی ہیومن ٹریفکنگ سرکل اسلام آباد کے حوالے کر دیا ہے۔

stories.title: Bangladesh secure draw in second Test against West Indies
stories.summary:
Bangladesh successfully forced a draw on the final day of the second Test against the West Indies in Sylhet, although the visitors claimed the two-match series 1-0 following their opening victory in Mirpur. Chasing a target of 369 runs, Bangladesh reached 184-4 when fading light halted play, with Litton Das on seven and Mehidy Hasan Miraz on one. The hosts' resilient chase was anchored by standout batter Towhid Hridoy, who set a new national record for the highest match aggregate in Test cricket.

Hridoy delivered a historic performance by following up his unbeaten 242 in the first innings with 82 runs in the second, surpassing Mominul Haque's previous aggregate record. His efforts helped Bangladesh overcome early trouble and secure a 30-run first-innings lead. During the match, veteran batter Mushfiqur Rahim also achieved a major milestone by becoming the first Bangladeshi cricketer to accumulate 7,000 Test runs, sharing a crucial 135-run partnership with Hridoy for the third wicket.

Earlier on the final day, the West Indies resumed at 345-3 and declared their second innings at 398-6 after Kavem Hodge posted a career-best 142 runs. Bangladesh's bowlers claimed regular wickets to restrict the visitors, with Taijul Islam, Mehidy Hasan Miraz, and Nayeem Hasan picking up two wickets each. Despite losing quick wickets during the run chase—including Hridoy and Mushfiqur falling to Jomel Warrican and Shamar Joseph—Bangladesh safely batted out the remaining time to draw the match.

stories.title: Israel and US Reportedly Negotiate New Multiyear Military Aid Framework
stories.summary:
Israel and the United States are reportedly engaged in negotiations for a new multiyear military aid agreement, according to an article published by the Israeli newspaper Yedioth Ahronoth. Israel is reportedly seeking to finalize the arrangement prior to the swearing-in of the new US Congress in January, aiming to prevent potential political disruptions. The Democratic Party recently secured control of Congress from President Donald Trump's Republican Party during the November 3 midterm elections.

Contrary to previous statements by President Trump suggesting an immediate halt to assistance, the emerging plan outlines a gradual phaseout rather than an abrupt termination. Under the proposal, direct military aid would be reduced by nearly half by shortening the standard 10-year framework to a five-year period following the expiration of the current agreement in 2028. Direct assistance would then conclude entirely. Under the existing 10-year Foreign Military Financing program, Israel receives $3.3 billion annually, totaling $33 billion, which is utilized to purchase American-made weapons and military hardware.

Concurrently, Washington is expected to increase financial backing for joint air and missile defense development, moving past the current $500 million annual allocation to an unspecified higher sum. This enhanced cooperation aims to counter growing threats from drones and missiles, benefiting the defense industries of both nations. Negotiating teams involve representatives from the US State Department under Secretary Marco Rubio, alongside officials from Israel's Defense Ministry and its embassy in Washington.

The report indicates that President Trump's earlier remarks regarding ending aid by the close of 2026 were driven by domestic political considerations, specifically to aid a Republican Senate candidate in Michigan. Officials emphasized that reducing military assistance could negatively impact American manufacturing and jobs, as the majority of the funding is spent within the United States. Meanwhile, the ongoing Gaza conflict since October 2023 has resulted in over 74,000 Palestinian deaths and widespread destruction of regional infrastructure, coinciding with a notable decline in American public favorability toward Israel.

stories.title: China Factory-Gate Inflation Hits 4.5-Year High While Consumer Growth Cools
stories.summary:
China reported that its producer inflation accelerated in October to reach its fastest rate in nearly four and a half years. According to the National Bureau of Statistics, the producer price index climbed 5.7% compared to the previous year, surpassing the 5.0% increase recorded in September and exceeding a Reuters poll forecast of a 5.3% rise. This marked the largest annual climb since June 2022.

The surge in factory-gate costs was primarily driven by high global oil prices resulting from the Middle East conflict. These energy costs raised expenses for sectors such as coal mining, oil and natural gas extraction, chemicals, and other energy-intensive industries. However, these upstream pressures have not fully translated to everyday shoppers because sluggish domestic demand continues to constrain household spending in the world's second-largest economy.

Conversely, the consumer price index rose by 0.7% year-on-year in October, cooling from a 0.9% increase in September and coming in just below economists' expectations of a 0.8% rise. Core inflation, which strips out volatile food and energy costs, also eased from 1.0% in September down to 0.8% in October, highlighting lingering underlying price pressures.

Analysts note that while the conflict in the Middle East may keep inflation elevated in the coming months, its impact is expected to fade next year. Meanwhile, robust export growth has kept the economy moving without immediate broad policy stimulus, though a weak stock market and soft consumer sentiment continue to pose challenges for domestic economic stability.

stories.title: کراچی پولیس کی کارروائیاں: ایک ہفتے میں 880 سے زائد ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
کراچی پولیس نے گزشتہ ایک ہفتے کے دوران شہر بھر میں کارروائیوں کے دوران 880 سے زائد ملزمان کو گرفتار کرنے کے اعداد و شمار جاری کر دیے ہیں۔ پولیس ترجمان کے مطابق اس دوران پولیس اور جرائم پیشہ افراد کے درمیان 43 مختلف مقابلے ہوئے۔

ان مقابلوں کے نتیجے میں 6 ڈاکو ہلاک اور 51 زخمی ہوئے جبکہ مجموعی طور پر 65 ملزمان کو حراست میں لیا گیا۔ پولیس کارروائیوں میں ہلاک ہونے والے افراد میں دو سگے بھائی بھی شامل ہیں جن کی لاشیں ضابطے کی کارروائی کے لیے اسپتال منتقل کر دی گئی ہیں۔

ترجمان نے مزید بتایا کہ کارروائیوں کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے 132 مختلف اقسام کا غیر قانونی اسلحہ برآمد کیا گیا۔ اس کے علاوہ مختلف چھاپوں میں 20 کلوگرام سے زائد منشیات جن میں چرس، آئس اور ہیروئن شامل ہیں، بھی پولیس نے اپنے قبضے میں لے لیں۔

پولیس نے کارروائیوں کے دوران چھینے یا چرائے گئے سامان کی برآمدگی کے حوالے سے بتایا کہ اس مدت میں 39 موٹر سائیکلیں اور 3 کاریں بھی برآمد کی گئی ہیں۔ محکمہ پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ شہر میں جرائم کے تدارک کے لیے اس طرح کی کارروائیاں بلا تعطل جاری رہیں گی۔

stories.title: Delhi Air Quality Plummets to Severe Levels Following Diwali Fireworks
stories.summary:
Air quality in India's capital city deteriorated sharply, plunging into the 'very poor' and 'severe' categories after residents set off fireworks to celebrate Diwali in direct violation of court orders. At 9 a.m. on Monday, Delhi recorded an overall air quality index of 370, which is classified as 'very poor' by the Central Pollution Control Board. Numerous locations across the metropolitan area of 20 million people registered readings exceeding 400, falling into the 'severe' classification.

Ahead of the celebrations, India's Supreme Court had mandated that only certified low-polluting firecrackers could be utilized during restricted hours over the holiday weekend. Despite these legal limitations, locals in both Delhi and Mumbai reported that firecrackers continued to detonate late into the night. Television broadcasts captured a dense layer of smog shrouding the India Gate landmark in central Delhi near major government buildings and parliament.

Live rankings from the Swiss group IQAir positioned Delhi as the third-most polluted city globally on Monday morning. Pakistan's Lahore held the top position with an alarming air quality index of 563, which is designated as hazardous. The worsening air conditions reflect a persistent seasonal cycle across northern India, where cold winter weather traps vehicle exhaust, construction dust, and smoke from agricultural waste burning.

Megacities like Delhi face magnified pollution challenges due to dense traffic volumes and continuous construction work, leaving local populations vulnerable to widespread respiratory ailments. In response to poor air quality levels persisting for over a week, local authorities implemented restrictions under a graded action plan on Friday, including a mandate for schools to switch to online classes.

stories.title: تربیلا توسیعی پن بجلی منصوبے کی کھدائی کے دوران چٹان گرنے کا واقعہ
stories.summary:
تربیلا پانچویں توسیعی پن بجلی منصوبے پر کنکٹنگ ٹنل کے سیکنڈ بنچ کی کھدائی کے دوران چٹان کا ایک کمزور حصہ گر گیا۔ اس حادثے کے نتیجے میں پانی ان ٹیک پٹ سے ٹنل اور پاور ہاؤس میں داخل ہو گیا۔ واپڈا کے ترجمان کے مطابق تمام ورکرز کو فوری طور پر بحفاظت نکال لیا گیا ہے اور اس واقعے میں کوئی جانی نقصان نہیں ہوا۔

ترجمان نے واضح کیا ہے کہ تربیلا کی ٹنل نمبر 5 کے منہدم ہونے کی زیر گردش اطلاعات غلط ہیں۔ پراجیکٹ کی مین ٹنل، زیر تعمیر پاور ہاؤس، ٹیل ریس کلورٹ اور سوئچ یارڈ کو کوئی نقصان نہیں پہنچا ہے۔ ان ٹیک پٹ سے پانی مکمل طور پر نکالا جا چکا ہے جبکہ زیر تعمیر پاور ہاؤس سے پانی نکالنے کا عمل بھی جاری ہے۔

واپڈا کے سینئر افسران، کنسلٹنٹس اور کنٹریکٹرز موجودہ صورت حال کا جائزہ لے رہے ہیں۔ اس منصوبے کا آغاز اگست 2021 میں ہوا تھا جس کے تحت 510 میگاواٹ صلاحیت کے 3 یونٹس لگائے جانے ہیں، اور اس سے کل 1530 میگاواٹ بجلی پیدا ہو گی۔ ٹنل سے پیداوار مئی تک متوقع ہے۔

منصوبے کے مالی اعداد و شمار کے مطابق، منظور شدہ پی سی ون کی تخمینہ لاگت 82 ارب روپے تھی، 2025 تک اس پر 128 ارب روپے خرچ ہو چکے ہیں جبکہ جنوری 2026 تک ٹنل فائیو پر 153 ارب روپے خرچ ہو چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: Trump Anticipates Trilateral Meeting With Xi and Putin at APEC Summit
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump announced on Sunday that he expects to hold discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin during the upcoming APEC leaders' summit. Speaking to reporters prior to his return flight to Washington from Florida, Trump confirmed his travel plans to attend the summit scheduled for November 18-19 in the southern Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen.

The American leader outlined several key diplomatic objectives for the anticipated gathering, highlighting nuclear non-proliferation and ongoing international efforts to bring a close to the war in Iran. In October, Trump had previously expressed openness toward participating in three-way arms control discussions centered on denuclearization with both Xi and Putin.

Additional reports from The Wall Street Journal indicated that Putin has floated the idea of utilizing this trilateral summit format to address a potential resolution to the prolonged Russia-Ukraine conflict. Trump further remarked during an interview with CBS' 60 Minutes program that he believes a deal to end the war is close, predicting a slightly altered future territorial shape for Ukraine.

The upcoming meetings in Shenzhen bring together top global powers amidst existing bilateral trade discussions and heightened geopolitical tensions. The anticipated encounter provides a platform for leaders to address multiple international security concerns, ranging from Middle Eastern conflicts to strategic arms limitations and European stability.

stories.title: بنگلا دیش کے تجربہ کار بیٹر مشفق الرحیم نے ٹیسٹ رنز کا سنگ میل عبور کر لیا
stories.summary:
بنگلادیش کے تجربہ کار بیٹر مشفق الرحیم نے ٹیسٹ کرکٹ میں سات ہزار رنز مکمل کر کے ایک نئی تاریخ رقم کر دی ہے۔ وہ یہ تاریخی اعزاز حاصل کرنے والے بنگلادیش کے پہلے بیٹر بن گئے ہیں۔ انہوں نے یہ سنگ میل ویسٹ انڈیز کے خلاف سلہٹ ٹیسٹ کے آخری روز کھانے کے وقفے کے بعد روسٹن چیز کی گیند پر ایک رن بنا کر عبور کیا۔

مشن کے اس تاریخی لمحے پر ڈریسنگ روم میں موجود ساتھی کھلاڑیوں نے کھڑے ہو کر ان کی حوصلہ افزائی کی۔ مشفق الرحیم اس سے قبل 2022 میں پانچ ہزار اور 2024 میں چھ ہزار ٹیسٹ رنز بنانے والے پہلے بنگلادیشی بیٹر بھی بن چکے ہیں۔ انہوں نے چھ ہزار سے سات ہزار رنز کا فاصلہ طے کرنے کے لیے صرف پچیس اننگز کھیلی ہیں۔

ٹیسٹ کرکٹ میں بنگلادیش کی طرف سے سب سے زیادہ سنچریاں بنانے کا اعزاز بھی مشفق الرحیم کے پاس ہے، جنہوں نے چودہ سنچریاں اسکور کی ہیں۔ سلہٹ ٹیسٹ ان کے کیریئر کا ایک سو ساتواں ٹیسٹ میچ ہے، اور وہ نومبر 2025 میں ایک سو ٹیسٹ کھیلنے والے پہلے بنگلادیشی کھلاڑی بھی بنے تھے۔

مشفق الرحیم نے دو ہزار پانچ میں بین الاقوامی کیریئر کا آغاز کیا تھا اور وقت کے ساتھ وہ ٹیم کا اہم ترین حصہ بن گئے۔ وہ ون ڈے میں چھ ہزار چھ سو ستانوے اور ٹی ٹوئنٹی انٹرنیشنل میں ایک ہزار چار سو پچانوے رنز بنا چکے ہیں، تاہم محدود اوورز کے ان دونوں فارمیٹس سے ریٹائرمنٹ لے چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: Private College Principal Booked in Bahawalpur for Alleged Student Rape
stories.summary:
Police in Musafirkhana have registered a formal case against the principal of a private college following allegations that he raped a first-year student. The incident reportedly took place in mauza Khanpur Mirchan, though law enforcement authorities confirmed that no arrests have been made thus far as the investigation continues.

According to the details provided in the police complaint by the victim's father, his 17-year-old daughter was waiting near the college gate to depart for home on November 3. The principal allegedly coerced her into his office and assaulted her. The father stated that the teenager disclosed the ordeal to her family immediately upon returning home.

The complainant added that members of his biradari initially discouraged him from approaching the police before he ultimately decided to file the official report. Local police officials from the Musafir Khana station confirmed that the case remains under active investigation while searching for the suspect.

In the wake of the incident, the victim's parents issued a public appeal directed to the Punjab chief minister. They requested immediate intervention and direct orders to the police force to ensure the swift apprehension of the accused principal.

stories.title: Pakistani Opposition Alliance Demands Judicial Review of K-P Emergency
stories.summary:
The Tehreek-e-Tahafuz-e-Ayin-e-Pakistan has called for a transparent judicial review regarding the imposition of governor's rule and an emergency in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa. Leaders including Mahmood Khan Achakzai, Allama Raja Nasir Abbas, and Asad Qaiser stated that these governance measures threaten provincial autonomy, public mandates, and parliamentary democracy. 

The emergency and governor's rule were initially approved on October 11 by President Asif Ali Zardari upon Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's recommendation, citing deteriorating security and counter-terrorism failures. This move transferred executive powers to Governor Faisal Karim Kundi and an advisory council across twelve districts, removing the cabinet of suspended Chief Minister Sohail Afridi.

The opposition alliance also demanded the immediate publication of medical reports for founding chairman Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi, alongside upholding the Supreme Court directive to move Khan to Shifa International Hospital. Furthermore, they urged the release of detained political workers and family members, while condemning actions against elected representatives.

Legal proceedings regarding the matter faced adjustments after the Peshawar High Court removed petitions challenging the emergency and detentions following a ruling by the Federal Constitutional Court. The opposition maintains that their democratic campaign against political victimisation will proceed through countrywide protests.

stories.title: Toto Wolff Celebrates Mercedes Constructors' Championship in Sao Paulo
stories.summary:
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff praised his organization after securing the constructors' championship at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. George Russell finished fourth and Kimi Antonelli placed fifth in the rain-affected race, allowing Mercedes to surpass Ferrari's points total and secure their ninth constructors' crown.
